# Technology Partners International (TPI) — Complete Company Information

> Technology Partners International (TPI) is Nigeria's leading environmental consultancy and engineering company, established in 1992. TPI provides ISO-certified environmental impact assessment (EIA), environmental compliance monitoring, laboratory testing, waste management, engineering, digital solutions, and professional training services across Nigeria and West Africa.

---

## Company Overview

Technology Partners International Nigeria Limited (TPI), commonly known as TPI Nigeria or TPI Group, is a trusted provider of environmental, laboratory, waste management, and advanced asset integrity services. Since 1992, TPI has been delivering high-quality solutions to clients in Nigeria and across the world.

TPI is both ISO/IEC 17025:2017–accredited and ISO 9001:2015–certified. These certifications reflect our commitment to global best practices in testing, measurement traceability, and quality management. TPI also holds ISO 14001:2015 for Environmental Management and ISO 45001:2018 for Occupational Health & Safety.

## Services in Detail

### 1. Environmental Consultancy Services

TPI is one of the leading environmental consultancy companies in Nigeria, providing comprehensive environmental services across the entire project lifecycle.

#### Environmental Planning & Management
TPI provides best-in-class expert advice that guarantees accelerated permit turnaround time, builds investors' confidence, and works within budget and schedule constraints. With over 30 years' experience and a global diverse team across Africa, TPI delivers sustainable value through risk identification and mitigation end-to-end of a project lifecycle.

Services include:
- Site feasibility studies
- Risk reviews and mitigations
- Environmental, Social, and Health Impact Assessments (ESHIA)
- Environmental Management Plans (EMP), Audits (EA) & Evaluation Studies (EES)
- IFC/World Bank Performance Standards compliance
- Stakeholders mapping and management
- Regulatory Permitting and Approvals
- Environmental risk modeling

#### Environmental Compliance Monitoring (ECM)
Routine environmental monitoring includes the collection and analysis of samples from various environmental media — air, water, and soil — to detect harmful pollutants or contaminants from industrial operations and facilities. TPI achieves a 100% regulatory compliance rate.

Monitoring includes:
- Aqueous: Surface water, Groundwater, Effluents & Runoffs
- Gaseous: Ambient/Indoor air, Stack emissions, Particulates
- Solids: Soil, Sediments, Waste & Landfill monitoring
- Bioaccumulated contaminants in organisms
- Bundled compliance audits, emergency response & training

#### Environmental Site Assessment & Characterization
TPI provides comprehensive Environmental Site Assessment (ESA) and Characterization services to help businesses identify and mitigate potential environmental risks in asset portfolio investment decisions, mergers, and acquisitions.

Services include:
- Phase I and II Environmental Site Assessments
- Transaction-screening assessments
- Soil and groundwater sampling & analysis
- Air quality and hazardous materials assessments
- ESG risk and liability reduction strategies

#### Climate Change, Sustainability & GHG Reporting
TPI offers expert ESG advisory services covering:
- GHG Inventory and Reporting (GHG Protocol, ISO 14064)
- ESG Risk Assessment and Training
- Carbon Footprint Reduction strategies
- Sustainability Strategy and Planning
- Energy efficiency and renewable energy implementation

#### Health, Social Engagement & Resettlement
Services include:
- Social Impact Assessments (SIA)
- Resettlement Action Plans (RAP)
- Environmental Social Management Frameworks (ESMF)
- Stakeholder mapping and community engagement
- Regional network of social and health impact specialists

#### Air Quality & Acoustics
TPI provides comprehensive air quality and acoustic measurement services:
- Ambient Air Quality (O3, NOx, SO2, CO, PM2.5, PM10, NH3, VOCs)
- Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) monitoring and certification
- Acoustics (Noise & Vibration) assessments (BS 4142)
- Stack Emission Monitoring (CEMS) and Extractive Sampling
- Air, Surface Water, and Groundwater Modeling

#### Clean-Up & Remediation Services
TPI is a trusted partner for innovative and cost-effective clean-up, spill control, and remediation of hazardous contamination sites, particularly from accidental spills in mining and oil and gas operations.

#### Hydrological & Hydrogeological Services
Expert solutions for water resources optimization, development impact assessment, and contaminated site remediation.

#### Geophysical & Geotechnical Services
Over 20 years of experience in delivering geophysical and geotechnical consulting solutions including seismic surveys, GPR, bathymetry, and foundation design.

#### Geographic Information System (GIS)
Advanced GIS and Remote Sensing services for spatial data analysis, custom mapping, pipeline route determination, and site suitability analysis.

---

### 2. Laboratory Services

TPI operates an ISO/IEC 17025:2017 accredited environmental laboratory in Nigeria. The laboratory follows ASTM, APHA, and USEPA methodologies.

#### General Laboratory Services
Testing of water (potable and non-potable), soil, sediment, plankton and benthic fauna, air, contaminants, and other environmental matrices. Analyses include microbiological, physicochemical, nutrients, metals, and organic compounds.

#### Remote & Mobile Laboratory Services
Fully equipped mobile laboratory units deployed to remote project sites with AAS, GC, and other testing equipment.

#### Eco-Toxicity, Bioaccumulation & Biodegradability
Full range of eco-toxicity testing including acute toxicity (fish, daphnia, algae), biodegradability studies, and bioaccumulation studies compliant with EGASPIN, OECD, ISO, and EPA standards.

#### Production Chemistry, Petroleum Product Testing & Crude Oil Assays
Specializing in process optimization, petroleum product quality testing (flash point, viscosity, corrosion), and crude oil assays (API gravity, sulfur, distillation).

#### Geochemical / Fingerprinting
Advanced crude oil fingerprinting including biomarker analysis (hopanes, steranes), isotope ratio determination, and spill source identification.

---

### 3. Waste Management Services

TPI provides end-to-end waste management solutions for both hazardous and non-hazardous waste streams.

#### Integrated Solid Waste Management (ISWM)
Strategic management covering waste generation, segregation, transfer, sorting, treatment, recovery, and disposal with emphasis on maximizing resource efficiency.

#### Incineration Systems
Design, operation, and management of incineration systems for medical, industrial, chemical, and municipal solid waste with strict emission controls.

#### Thermal Desorption
Advanced heat-based separation technology for remediating PCB-contaminated soils, oily sludges, and industrial hazardous waste.

#### Policy Formulation & Compliance
Development of waste management plans, regulatory permits, and environmental policies aligned with NESREA guidelines and DPR regulations.

---

### 4. Engineering / EPC & Asset Integrity

#### Engineering Design
Conceptual and FEED engineering for onshore and offshore infrastructure using 3D modeling and international codes (API, ASME, BS).

#### Asset Integrity Management
Risk-based inspection (RBI), corrosion monitoring, fitness-for-service assessments, and non-destructive testing (NDT) for lifecycle extension.

---

### 5. Digital Solutions

#### Security & Software Solutions
Environmental data management platforms, automated compliance data collection, and secure scalable software infrastructure.

#### Data Management & Reporting
Efficient environmental data storage, verification, statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and stakeholder reporting.

---

### 6. Training

#### ESG Training
Professional development on sustainability standards (GRI, ISO 26000) and environmental risk management.

#### Customized Training
Bespoke training solutions including gap analysis, needs assessment, curriculum design, and competency certification.

#### Environmental Laboratory Training
Specialized instrumentation and quality control training including sample preparation, AAS, GC instrumentation, and laboratory safety.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA)?
An Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) is a systematic process to evaluate the potential environmental effects of a proposed project or development. In Nigeria, EIA is a legal requirement under the EIA Act (Cap E12, LFN 2004) and is regulated by the Federal Ministry of Environment. TPI has over 30 years of experience conducting EIAs for oil & gas, infrastructure, power, and mining projects.

### What environmental services does TPI offer in Nigeria?
TPI offers comprehensive environmental services including Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA), Environmental Evaluation Studies (EES), Compliance Monitoring, Site Assessments, Air Quality Monitoring, Clean-Up & Remediation, Hydrological Services, Geophysical & Geotechnical Services, GIS Mapping, and Climate Change & Sustainability advisory.

### Is TPI ISO certified for environmental management?
Yes. TPI holds ISO 14001:2015 certification for Environmental Management Systems, ISO 9001:2015 for Quality Management, ISO 45001:2018 for Occupational Health & Safety, and ISO/IEC 17025:2017 accreditation for laboratory testing and calibration.

### How long does an EIA take to complete in Nigeria?
The timeline typically ranges from 3 to 12 months, depending on complexity and the regulatory review process. TPI achieves a 98% permit approval success rate.

### What environmental regulations apply to businesses in Nigeria?
Key regulations include the EIA Act (Cap E12, LFN 2004), the NESREA Act, sector-specific guidelines from NUPRC, and various state environmental protection laws. International standards such as IFC Performance Standards and Equator Principles may also apply.
